title: Billing
ownersOnly: Only owners manage billing. Please ask the owner of your organization.
unavailable: Billing is not set up in this installation. Plans cannot be bought here.
price: {interval, select, day {{amount} per day} week {{amount} per week} month {{amount} per month} year {{amount} per year} other {{amount}}}

current.title: Current plan
current.net: Net; Stripe Tax adds the tax of your country.
current.trialEnds: The trial ends on {date}. After that your organization is read-only until you choose a plan.
current.ends: Ends on {date}. After that your organization is read-only.
current.manageHint: Payment method, billing address and cancellation are managed in the customer portal of Stripe.

readOnly.title: Your organization is read-only
readOnly.body: Since {date} no content can be created or changed, and scheduled posts are paused. Your data is kept. Choose a plan to work as usual again.

pastDue.title: The last payment failed
pastDue.body: Please check the payment method in the customer portal. If the payment has not arrived by {date}, your organization becomes read-only.

checkout.success: Thank you for your payment. Your plan changes in a few seconds.
checkout.canceled: The checkout was canceled. Your plan stays as it is.

usage.title: Usage
usage.full: Limit reached: anything new needs an upgrade.
usage.fullMonthly: Limit of this month reached: anything new waits for next month or an upgrade.
usage.over: Beyond the limit of your plan: what exists is kept, anything new is blocked. Reduce to {limit} or choose a larger plan.
usage.overMonthly: Beyond the limit of your plan: what is planned stays, anything new can be planned next month, or you choose a larger plan.
usage.aiIncluded: {included} included, beyond that up to {limit} as billed overage.
usage.aiOverage: Overage this month: {amount}. It is billed with the next invoice.
usage.aiFull: The AI budget of this month is used up.
usage.xApiFull: The X API budget of this month is used up. Posts through the X API wait for next month.

offer.title: Plans
offer.description: Prices per month, net. A change applies at once; Stripe prorates the difference.

features.accounts: {count, plural, one {# connected account} other {# connected accounts}}
features.posts: {count, plural, one {# post per month} other {# posts per month}}
features.history: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of analytics history
features.xBrowser: X without the API through the browser

change.title: Switch to {plan}?
change.description: The change applies at once. Stripe prorates the difference with the next invoice.
change.beyond: After the change you are beyond these limits. What exists is kept, but anything new is blocked until you have reduced it:
change.history: The new plan keeps analytics for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Older analytics are deleted in the night after the change and do not come back with a later upgrade.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.caption: The latest invoices of your organization

notice.readOnly: Your organization is read-only because no plan is active. Scheduled posts are paused.
notice.pastDue: The last payment failed. Without a payment by {date}, your organization becomes read-only.
notice.askOwner: The owner of your organization can change this under Billing.
